links.outcome: AI model versus clinician ratings on accuracy, completeness, readability, reliability for HIV-CVD guideline questions
links.effect: All AI models scored higher than clinicians across all dimensions (P<.001); AI mean 3.44-3.68 vs clinicians mean 1.78-2.05; DeepSeek-R1 best.
links.quote: All AI models achieved significantly higher scores than clinicians across all dimensions (P<.001).

screen.reason: Compares performance of four LLMs against clinicians in answering clinical management questions using a structured 25-question guideline-based assessment, but does not evaluate a deployment guardrail or practice.
